presets.title: Urban Street Graph & Occlusion
presets.subtitle: ATP 4-11 Urban Convoy & Blind Corner Occlusion (Issue #16)
presets.desc: Convoy maneuvering through city street corridors with 4 solid masonry building blocks. When rounding 90-degree corners, vehicles lose direct line-of-sight and seamlessly transition to dead-reckoning on surveyed street lanes, avoiding corner-cutting through buildings.

presets.title: Tactical MSR Convoy with Escorts & Ambush
presets.subtitle: ATP 4-11 / FM 4-0 Force Protection & Payload Delivery (Issue #8 & #9)
presets.desc: 15-vehicle doctrinal column (3 March Units of 5 vehicles) carrying 40 tons of sustainment payload. Armed gun trucks (ROLE_SECURITY) protect cargo transporters against an ambush along the defilade ridge, demonstrating FM 4-0 throughput and loss attribution.

presets.title: Doctrinal Spacing: Dispersed Open Column (6.0s Gap)
presets.subtitle: ATP 4-16 Movement Control Appendix C (Issue #10 & #11)
presets.desc: High headway (6.0s / 84m gap) minimizes vulnerability to indirect artillery and roadside ambushes, but expands column road space to 1,240m.

presets.title: Arc-Length Stationing: 90-Degree Turn
presets.subtitle: ATP 4-16 App. C & ATP 4-11 Lane Discipline (Issue #13)
presets.desc: Convoys track the road centerline using 1D arc-length coordinates s. Follower targets stay constrained to the surveyed road curve, eliminating corner-cutting across ditches and obstacles.
